observations: Industrial sewing machine on a metal stand.
Brand 'JINLONG' is visible on the side of the machine head in photo 0.
The machine is powered by a foot pedal located at the base of the stand.
A power cord is visible extending from the machine.
The machine head appears to be in good cosmetic condition.

claims.evidence: The machine is shown powered on, but the actual sewing function and stitch quality cannot be confirmed from a still photo.

risks.risk: The machine may not sew or may produce poor quality stitches.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine sewing through fabric.

risks.risk: The motor may be noisy, overheating, or failing to run.
risks.proof: A video of the motor running at full speed.

risks.risk: The needle may be bent or the needle bar may be damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the needle and the needle bar area.

proof_requests: Video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric to demonstrate stitch quality and motor operation.
Close-up photo of the needle and the needle bar.
Video of the motor running to check for noise or overheating.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
